name: Quattro Command
author: Gavin Nugent
description: A vector missile-defence cabinet for omarchy-shell. Six cities, three launchers, warheads that split and bombs that dodge — drawn as glowing vectors on a curved phosphor screen in your live theme colours. Summon with: omarchy-shell shell toggle nosignal.quattro-command

barWidget.description: Bar icon that toggles the Quattro Command cabinet
